claim: Services available locally in Local Zones include Amazon EC2, VPC, EBS, FSx, Elastic Load Balancing, EMR, ElastiCache and RDS; orchestration services such as EC2 Auto Scaling, EKS, ECS, Systems Manager, CloudWatch, CloudTrail and CloudFormation can work with them.

claim: You extend a VPC from the parent Region into a Local Zone by creating a new subnet and assigning it to the Local Zone; the VPC then treats that subnet like a subnet in any other Availability Zone.
question: FAQ: How does Amazon VPC work in Local Zones?

values.display: creating a new subnet and assigning it to the Local Zone
values.spoken: you create a subnet in the Local Zone and the VPC extends there

evidence.quote: You can extend any VPC from the parent Region into Local Zones by creating a new subnet and assigning it to the Local Zone. When you create a subnet in a Local Zone, your VPC is extended to that Local Zone and your VPC will treat the subnet as any subnet in any other Availability Zone, and relevant gateways, route tables, and so on will be automatically adjusted.
